bagPolicy.summary: Patrons may only bring one clear bag no larger than 12"x12"x6".
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: More than 10,000 parking spaces are available within a 10-minute walk of Rupp Arena. Parking fees apply for most events, with payments accepted via major credit cards and mobile payments. Prepaid parking is available for some events through ParkWhiz.
lots: Rupp Arena parking lot on West High Street

rideshare.note: Your Uber or Lyft driver can drop-off or pick-up patrons just steps from the door.

concessions.note: Hardwood & Oak offers a unique food and hospitality experience at Rupp Arena, featuring classic southern staples like stone-ground grits and bourbon braised short ribs. They provide a range of services from cocktail receptions to full dinner menus, emphasizing fresh ingredients and southern hospitality.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Rupp Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Rupp Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Rupp Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Rupp Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
